task_defect.reason: Requirements R22 and R29 contain arithmetic errors that contradict the source request and Requirements R15, R16, R17, and R18. From the prompt, total pack cost is INR 830,000, current assembly is INR 107,900 (USD 1,300 x 83), and current overhead is INR 16,600 (USD 200 x 83). Unchanged child-part cost is therefore 830,000 - 107,900 - 16,600 = 705,500 INR (not 683,000 INR as assumed in R22). Adding localized assembly (20,000 INR) and overhead (590 INR) yields a localized pack cost of 726,090 INR (a 103,910 INR or 12.52% reduction), not 703,590 INR (~15.2% reduction).
